ITEM 1 | Crumbled/cubed white soft cheese-like pieces, matte off-white with slight cream tint, irregular crumbly chunks about 1-2 cm, clustered on upper-left of plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Ground brown meat mixture, granular texture, dark brown with tan edges, slightly moist with small crumbles, spread across lower-left center of plate about 9 cm across | 110
ITEM 3 | Whole green grapes, glossy pale green with slight translucency, smooth skin, roughly 2 cm diameter, scattered across center of plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Halved cherry tomato, glossy red skin with darker red shading, about 2 cm across, sitting near center top of cheese | 12
ITEM 5 | Golden-brown roasted potato cubes, about 1.5-2 cm pieces, crisp-looking edges with light browning, slightly matte, scattered across center and right of plate | 85
ITEM 6 | Sliced banana rounds or pieces, pale cream-yellow with slight browning at edges, soft, about 1 cm thick and 3-4 cm long, lying under and beside the meat on lower left | 55
ITEM 7 | Broccoli florets, vivid dark green with slightly lighter stems, firm, bushy tops about 3-4 cm across, two clusters on right and bottom of plate | 75
ITEM 8 | Small pieces of roasted white-and-golden squash or potato-like cubes with light browning, about 1.5 cm, scattered near grapes on right side | 25
